claims: The existing artifacts can audit custody and several mechanical representation properties.
They cannot establish genuine real-user usefulness or overall answer quality.
One bounded fan-in contract is earned as the next design task; no runtime implementation or model call is yet authorized.
repair_selection_reason: Two reviewed false stand-downs share an upstream representation gap; the corpus also lacks distinct missingness-aware surfaces for unresolved and reopen semantics. A fan-in contract addresses observability and preservation without adding a brittle semantic gate.

deterministic_limits: do not fill a missing role
do not infer roles from time, keywords, or order
do not decide model relevance or pressure
selected_next_repair.expected_changed_measurement: A downstream consumer can inspect every reader's explicit output and absence state without one missing read becoming stand-down evidence.
selected_next_repair.name: missingness-aware system-level conversation-state fan-in contract
selected_next_repair.scope: Design one typed assembly boundary that preserves complementary provider-authored starting, current, qualification, unresolved-matter, reopen-condition, and relationship records with source locators and explicit missing, empty, partial, and failed states.

what_is_exactly_measurable: completed, partial, failed, missing, empty, and not-applicable states
explicit role labels and record counts
source alias resolution, speaker, and turn locators
declared direct and graph routing activity
what_still_requires_probabilistic_or_hum: whether pressure improves a future answer
